title: Propagate a parsing error
summary: Parse an unsigned number, propagate a failure and wrap a successful value. No panic is needed for invalid input.

return.clue: Return type combining a successful value and a recoverable error

propagate.clue: Operator that returns early with the parsing error in this function

number.clue: Unsigned integer type with a width of 32 bits

error.clue: Standard-library error type returned by failed integer parsing

parse.clue: String method that attempts conversion to the specified target type

failed.clue: Method that reports whether the result contains a failure
